name: Bad Herrenalb (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically red and white, charged above the centre with the city arms of Bad Herrenalb (an abbot with a crozier on black).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Herrenalb; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Herrenalb arms — abbot on black
